semanticLinkContract: semantic-links.json and semantic-links.md define finite target kinds, canonical nested locators, association/payload preimages and multiplicity; no containing-node or alternate resolver fallback.
sourceDefault: All fields, scalar types, optional presence, nulls, array order and map key sets EXACT. No unknown-field fallback. Never rewrite raw /0 or /1 reports.
specialRules: All logical paths identical across fresh admitted host instances; no generic path substitution. Actual mounting identities retained and verified by host.

ProjectIdentity.use is exact manifest-pinned JSON bytes represented base64; require admitted manifest closed schema and compare preimage, do not erase arbitrary keys.
behaviorfalsify plan_preimage, workspace_before/after, marker and plan digests stay exact. If disposable path causes variation, use identical qualified logical mounts; never strip these digests.
